none: PAS SOM-7117B2: SOM-7117B2: Roman Samian Ware vessel
contea di ritrovamento: Dorset (Inghilterra e Galles)

Fragment of the base of a Roman Samian Ware vessel, probably of East Gaulish manufacture. Around a quarter of the base of the vessel survives, this rises slightly towards the centre of the upper face.
